name: Sign in and create a business workspace
description: Verifies a signed-in user can create a named supermarket workspace and it remains available after reload.
steps: Sign in using the AppDeploy login screen
Enter business name QA Supermarket and choose Supermarket
expected: The signed-in owner returns to the QA Supermarket workspace without creating a duplicate business.

name: Save and retrieve products in the business cloud inventory
description: Verifies products are stored in the selected business workspace and remain available after a new session load.
steps: Sign in to the QA Supermarket business
Open Products and add QA Rice with SKU QA-001, stock 12, cost 800 and selling price 1000
expected: QA Rice appears with the saved stock, SKU and prices after refresh.

name: Record a sale and reduce stock
description: Verifies an authorized business member can record a sale and see the persisted inventory quantity and sale history.
setup: Create product QA Beans with stock 10, cost 500 and selling price 700 in the QA Supermarket workspace
steps: Record a sale of 2 QA Beans paid by Cash
expected: A sale for 2 QA Beans appears in history and the product stock is 8 after refresh.

name: Reject invalid product data and keep another business private
description: Verifies invalid product values are rejected by the backend and a user cannot read another business by changing its business ID.
steps: Open Products on a mobile viewport
Attempt to save a product with a zero selling price
Attempt to open business data using a business ID not owned or shared with this account
expected: The invalid product is not saved and the unrelated business data request is denied.

name: Show approved subscription prices without enabling checkout
covers: Starter Business and Premium monthly pricing
description: Verifies all approved monthly and annual prices are visible and the subscription page clearly states that payment collection is not active.
steps: Review the Starter, Business and Premium monthly prices
expected: The page shows Starter ₦5,000 monthly and ₦50,000 annually, Business ₦10,000 and ₦100,000, Premium ₦20,000 and ₦200,000, and states that checkout is not active.
